prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent decorative overlay for a portrait-format architectural website photograph
Primary request: create a very sparse, badly hand-drawn border that can sit around the outside edge of a tall rectangular bathroom photograph. The border should look casually drawn directly on warm paper by a builder with a soft graphite pencil: slightly wobbly rectangular strokes, gaps, imperfect double-lines, and just three or four tiny naive wildflower marks sprouting from corners or short edges.
Input images: Image 1 is a style reference for the simple imperfect botanical line quality; Image 2 is a style reference for restrained graphite construction drawing and line weight.
Composition/framing: portrait rectangular frame with a very large completely empty transparent center; all artwork confined to a thin perimeter band; keep the left and right borders narrow and allow a few flower stems to extend slightly outward. It must be usable as a CSS overlay around an existing 3:4 portrait photo.
Style/medium: authentic rough graphite pencil, visibly human, understated, unpolished, slightly uneven pressure; not cute or decorative-crafty.
Color palette: soft charcoal gray only, no blue, no color fill.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background and transparent center; no paper texture; no opaque field; no text; no photo; no shadows; sparse enough that the photograph remains dominant; border must read clearly at web size.
Avoid: polished botanical illustration, symmetrical wreath, vector-perfect lines, ornate frame, dense flowers, scrapbook aesthetic, watercolor, white background, black background, watermark.
